changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.accounts ( account_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('minicore.accounts_account_id_seq'), account_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE, product_type minicore.product_type_enum NOT NULL, status minicore.account_status_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', available_balance NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, collected_balance NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, currency_code VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.transactions ( transaction_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('minicore.transactions_transaction_id_seq'), account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.accounts(account_id), transaction_code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, direction minicore.transaction_direction_enum NOT NULL, status minicore.transaction_status_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', json_payload JSONB, effective_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT chk_transaction_code CHECK (transaction_code IN ('DEP','WDL','TFR','FEE','INT','ADJ','PMT','REV','CHK','ACH','WIR')), CONSTRAINT chk_amount_positive CHECK (amount > 0) )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.transaction_balances ( transaction_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES minicore.transactions(transaction_id), account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.accounts(account_id), available_balance NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, collected_balance NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_accounts ( event_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, operation_type minicore.operation_type_enum NOT NULL, snapshot_type VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL CHECK (snapshot_type IN ('PRE', 'POS')), account_id BIGINT NOT NULL, account_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, product_type minicore.product_type_enum NOT NULL, status minicore.account_status_enum NOT NULL, available_balance NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, collected_balance NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, currency_code VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, account_created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, account_updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, processed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_transactions ( event_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, operation_type minicore.operation_type_enum NOT NULL, transaction_id BIGINT NOT NULL, account_id BIGINT NOT NULL, transaction_code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, direction minicore.transaction_direction_enum NOT NULL, status minicore.transaction_status_enum NOT NULL, json_payload JSONB, effective_date DATE NOT NULL, transaction_created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, processed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_accounts_bulk ( bulk_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, first_event_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.outbox_accounts(event_id), last_event_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.outbox_accounts(event_id), status minicore.bulk_status_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CREATED', sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ, confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT chk_accounts_bulk_range CHECK (last_event_id >= first_event_id) )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_transactions_bulk ( bulk_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, first_event_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.outbox_transactions(event_id), last_event_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.outbox_transactions(event_id), status minicore.bulk_status_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CREATED', sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ, confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_bulk_range CHECK (last_event_id >= first_event_id) )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_accounts_confirmations ( event_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES minicore.outbox_accounts(event_id), dtw_confirmation VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_transactions_confirmations ( event_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES minicore.outbox_transactions(event_id), dtw_confirmation VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_accounts_sync_wait_confirmation ( event_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES minicore.outbox_accounts(event_id), bulk_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.outbox_accounts_bulk(bulk_id), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.outbox_transactions_sync_wait_confirmation ( event_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES minicore.outbox_transactions(event_id), bulk_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.outbox_transactions_bulk(bulk_id), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.dtw_transaction_mapping ( local_transaction_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES minicore.transactions(transaction_id), dtw_transaction_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, sync_status minicore.sync_status_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.sync_cursors ( cursor_name VARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY, last_processed_event_id BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )

changeSet.author: mini-core
mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.transaction_codes ( transaction_code NUMERIC(5) PRIMARY KEY, description VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL )

changeSet.author: mini-core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE minicore.transaction_code_balance_effects ( transaction_code NUMERIC(5) NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.transaction_codes(transaction_code), balance_name VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL REFERENCES minicore.balances(balance_name), effect SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (effect IN (-1, 1)), PRIMARY KEY (transaction_code, balance_name) )
